name: Fifteen Hours
title: A Guardsman Lasts 15 HOURS... This One Had 1 Left 💀 #warhammer40k
description:
First day on the front line, and the Sergeant has bad news about how long Guardsmen last. ⏱️💀

📜 THE LORE
• The Imperial Guard (Astra Militarum) is the Imperium's army: billions of ordinary humans with flak armour and a lasgun, thrown at threats that Space Marines are too few to stop.
• "15 hours" is the most famous joke statistic in the fandom: the average life expectancy of a Guardsman in combat. It shows how cheap a single soldier's life is to the Imperium.
• Commissars are political officers attached to Guard regiments. They keep morale up by any means, and they may execute soldiers on the spot for cowardice or retreat, which is why "Retreat is heresy" is no joke.
• Orks are green-skinned aliens who live for war. Their mighty charge is the "WAAAGH!", and a single Ork is far stronger and tougher than a human, so a rookie dropping one with a lasgun is a real achievement.

How long would YOU last in the Imperial Guard? 👇

name: Red Wunz Go Fasta
title: In 40k, RED Paint Makes You FASTER (Seriously) 🔴 #warhammer40k
description:
An Ork Mek paints his buggy red, and it really goes faster. 🔴💨

📜 THE LORE
• Orks give off a psychic field without knowing it. When enough Orks believe something, that shared belief bends reality, so Ork guns made of scrap still fire and their junk machines still run.
• "Red wunz go fasta" is the most famous example: Orks believe red vehicles are faster, so red vehicles really are faster. The Evil Sunz clan, obsessed with speed, paint everything red for this reason.
• Meks (Mekboyz) are the Ork engineers who build and "improve" their vehicles and weapons, mostly by instinct.
• It only works for Orks. A human painting his tank red gets nothing, unless the Orks decide it belongs to them.
• To the Imperial Guard, leaving the battlefield without orders is desertion, a crime the Commissars punish without mercy.

What's the most ridiculous Ork logic that actually works? 👇
